READY FOR STORIES THAT CELEBRATE YOU? PELIKULAYA: ENCOUNTERS IS HERE! 

The Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) proudly presents the full film lineup of PELIKULAYA: Encounters — a bold and beautiful celebration of LGBTQ+ stories that connect, empower, and inspire.

This Pride Month, dive into heartfelt stories, join thought-provoking conversations, and honor  love, identity, and community  in this year’s curation at Pelikulaya.

Let’s celebrate our stories in PELIKULAYA: Encounters!

JUNE 21 to 29, 2025
- YOUNG HEARTS
- PORTRAIT OF A LADY ON FIRE
- PIERCE

JULY 3 to 6, 2025
- FULL-LENGTH CLASSICS & CONTEMPORARY
- PELIKULAYA SHORTS
- EMBASSY SCREENINGS

JULY 12, 2025
- THE WEDDING BANQUET
- REBELS OF THE NEON GOD
- TANGERINE

Participating cinemas coming soon!

#FDCP #MovieOn #PhilippineCinema #PelikulayaEncounters #PrideMonth
